mission: Walk the post-Z refund counter-entry cascade end-to-end and verify every cross-system touchpoint: POS UI -> backend -> mirror order -> NF525 audit chain -> loyalty clawback (J2-HEAL-07) -> cash_movements -> drawer reconciliation -> receipt REMBOURSEMENT marker (G2-HEAL-01+03) -> KDS / OSS exclusion -> sealed-Z guard -> multi-refund uniqueness. Confirm prior heals still hold inside the live cascade and surface NEW gaps that prior single-system audits missed.
scope: Static cascade trace, code-only. No live boot. 11 hunts K5.1-K5.11 across 16 files (1 service, 4 listeners, 1 controller, 2 resources, 1 model, 1 guard, 1 payment service, 1 state machine, 1 OSS service, 1 KDS Vue component, 1 receipt Vue marker, 1 event, 5 test sentinels cross-referenced).
method: Walk the refund cascade left-to-right exactly once: POST /api/admin/pos-order/{order}/refund-with-counter-entry -> PosOrderController -> SealedOrderGuard::assertSealed -> RefundWithCounterEntryService::execute DB::transaction (mirror Order + items + payments + audit row + loyalty refundPoints) -> RefundCreated::dispatch (DispatchableAfterCommit) -> 4-listener cascade [Persist payment_status -> ReleaseStock -> ReleaseAvailability -> ClawbackLoyaltyPoints] -> Echo broadcast OrderPaymentStatusChanged -> KDS filter _statusChangeAffectsKds excludes DELIVERED->REFUNDED -> OSS allowlist whereIn(KIOSK, TAKEAWAY) + whereIn(status [PREPARING, PREPARED]) excludes status=22 RETURNED -> OrderDetailsResource serializes parent_order_id -> ReceiptRemboursementMarker.vue renders. Per-hunt verdict: VERIFIED CITED (cite prior heal commit/report) OR GAP (cite file:line where contract breaks).

hunts.name: Loyalty clawback cascade (NEW per J2-HEAL-07)
hunts.findings: VERIFIED END-TO-END — RefundCreated::dispatch (RefundWithCounterEntryService:260) -> EventServiceProvider:195 dispatches to ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund LAST in cascade. Listener (ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund.php:43-94) resolves loyalty user via loyalty_customer_code fallback to user_id, calls LoyaltyService::clawbackEarnedPoints(user.id, order.loyalty_points_awarded, order.id, reason). Service (LoyaltyService.php:141-199) writes manual_deduct LoyaltyTransaction with negative points + clamps balance at 0 + idempotent via existence check + UNIQUE (user_id, order_id, type). PROVEN END-TO-END by LoyaltyClawbackOnRefundSentinelTest.php — dispatches RefundCreated::dispatchNow (NOT direct service call) so a regression where ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund is unregistered from EventServiceProvider also turns red (lines 25-29 docstring confirms). Test cases verified: (a) 300pts awarded -> refund -> 0pts + manual_deduct ledger row (96-125), (b) double-dispatch idempotent NOOP (133-167), (c) balance clamp at 0 when current<awarded (174-199), (d) anonymous order safe NOOP (206-246), (e) zero-awarded NOOP (253-276). Complementary to refundPoints (manual_add) called separately inside the service transaction (RefundWithCounterEntryService:253) — distinct concerns (refundPoints reverses REDEEM, clawback debits EARN). Both can coexist atomically with no conflict (separate type ENUM values, separate UNIQUE keys).

hunts.name: Cash drawer movement
hunts.findings: GAP — K5-NEW-2 [P1]. RefundWithCounterEntryService::execute() does NOT record a CashMovement row for the counter-entry refund — verified by grep returning ZERO matches in the file for `recordCashBackMovement` / `CashMovement::` / `cashService` / `CashDrawerService`. Counterpart PaymentService::cashBack() DOES (PaymentService.php:471-508 recordCashBackMovement with TYPE_CASHBACK + DIRECTION_OUT, finding open session via CashDrawerService::findOpenSessionForUser). Impact: Z report aggregation still balances per-mode because ZReportService::aggregate derives cash from order_payments rows (mirror OrderPayment with mode=1=CASH, amount=-N negated is present per iter15-P0-10 fix at RefundWithCounterEntryService:175-204), BUT the drawer-session reconciliation surface — cash_movements joined to cash_drawer_sessions for end-of-shift expected-vs-actual count — has NO refund line. Cashier sees drawer expected count unchanged on a CASH refund; physical cash count is N euros short; reconciliation surface ledger shows an ecart that cannot be traced to a refund movement. Per I.1 finding silent-fail risk in the scope statement. Note: parent path PaymentService::cashBack DOES record the movement, so this gap is specific to the post-Z counter-entry path. P1, not P0, because (a) Z report balances correctly via order_payments, (b) NF525 audit chain captures the refund via audit_logs 'order.refund.counter_entry' (auditable forensic trail intact), (c) cash drawer skew can be reconciled manually by cashier inspecting the audit log for the day. V1.0.X backlog: add recordCashRefundMovement helper in RefundWithCounterEntryService mirroring PaymentService:471-508 pattern, also self-shielded (try/catch + Log::warning) so movement failure does not abort outer tx.

hunts.name: Receipt prints with REMBOURSEMENT marker
hunts.findings: VERIFIED CITED with GAP K5-NEW-1 [P2]. ReceiptRemboursementMarker.vue (commit 8ebbd057a / F2-HEAL-03) renders correctly: red dashed border + REMBOURSEMENT label + optional parent serial line. Trigger: parent_order_id is positive int (line 47-49). Co-exists with DUPLICATA marker as designed. i18n fallback resolves label.remboursement -> 'REMBOURSEMENT' string (lines 57-67). Sentinel: tests/js/sentinels/refundReceiptMarkerSentinel.spec.js. GAP K5-NEW-1: ReceiptRemboursementMarker.vue:50-56 reads order.parent_order_serial_no FIRST (fallback to order.parent.order_serial_no). VERIFIED by grep returning ZERO matches: (a) OrderDetailsResource does NOT serialize parent_order_serial_no (only parent_order_id at line 36), (b) Order model has NO parent_order_serial_no accessor, (c) Order model has NO parent() belongsTo relation (grep returned only hasMany OrderItem at line 144 and hasMany OrderPayment at line 187), (d) controller call $mirror->load('orderItems') does NOT eager-load parent. Result: parent serial line on the marker is ALWAYS null in the UI — '#NNN' traceability hint never renders. Visual P2 gap (label REMBOURSEMENT shows correctly so cashier sees the marker; just no parent serial number for trace-back to original sale). Fix is one line in OrderDetailsResource: 'parent_order_serial_no' => $this->parent?->order_serial_no with $this->loadMissing('parent') above, or add parent() relation on Order model + load it in controller. NF525-non-blocking — audit chain has the parent serial in audit_logs payload (RefundWithCounterEntryService:215). UX-only gap on the printed ticket.

hunts.name: Refund + Stock release cascade (per I2-HEAL-01)
hunts.findings: VERIFIED CITED — Both ReleaseStockOnRefundCreated and ReleaseAvailabilityOnRefundCreated are wrapped in try/catch + Log::error swallow per I2-HEAL-01 cascade-isolation pattern. ReleaseStockOnRefundCreated (lines 13-32) calls StockService::releaseForOrder($order, 'refund', refundedItems) — full refund signaled by empty refundedItems array. ReleaseAvailabilityOnRefundCreated (lines 31-89) iterates orderItems, maps to release line items, calls AvailabilityService::releaseForOrderItems (idempotent via released_qty ledger). Echo broadcast ItemAvailabilityChanged fires from AvailabilityService — kiosk cache invalidates (per CV1-KDS-INFLIGHT-OOS-MARKER-001 in KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1862-1867). Cascade defense-in-depth: even if Stock listener throws first (ZERO swallow pre-heal would propagate), Availability listener still fires (HEAL-I.4 hardening). Sentinel: tests/Feature/Stock/StockReleaseOnRefundTest.php.

hunts.name: Split-tranche refund (NOT supported per H.2 V1.0.2 backlog)
hunts.findings: VERIFIED CITED — V1.0.X deferred. RefundWithCounterEntryService mirrors ALL parent OrderPayment tranches with negated amounts (per iter15-P0-10 fix lines 155-204) — full refund only. Partial-by-tranche (refund CARD but keep CASH) requires (a) frontend selection of which tranche to refund, (b) backend mirror creation for only selected tranches, (c) Z report aggregation per-tranche-net=0 invariant relaxation. Sister scenarios untouched: items[] array on RefundCreated event supports per-line partial refunds at the AVAILABILITY level (ReleaseAvailabilityOnRefundCreated:42-74 honors event.refundedItems for partial paths) but the financial side currently full-refunds-only. Note: ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund clawback is full-amount (lines 30-35 docstring acknowledges pro-rated clawback deferred to V1.0.2 once partial-refund semantics finalized across cash-trail). Backlog reference: project_wave_x_test_e2e_convergence_2026-05-21 docs P8-FRICTION-2.

hunts.name: Post-Z-close refund
hunts.findings: VERIFIED CITED — SealedOrderGuard::assertSealed (SealedOrderGuard.php:84-114) enforces post-Z-only with the EXACT predicate as assertMutable (ZReport CLOSED with opened_at<order.created_at<=closed_at). Pre-Z parent throws InvalidArgumentException 422 'Order N is not in a CLOSED Z window — operation "refund-with-counter-entry" requires a sealed (post-Z) parent. Use the standard pre-Z path instead.' Cashier sees 422 with friendly message (PosOrderController.php:74-78 returns response success=false + message). Note: error message says 'Use the standard pre-Z path' — but per K5-DUP-1, no UI exists to trigger either path. Sentinel: tests/Feature/Sentinels/RefundCounterEntryRequiresSealedParentSentinelTest.php (verified by RefundCounterEntryUniqueParentTest.php as well, line 115). WAVE5-POS-001 rationale: without this guard, a still-open Z parent could receive a mirror immediately AND a separate cashier could transition the still-mutable parent to RETURNED via the standard pre-Z path — yielding 2 negatives for 1 sale in the same Z window.

hunts.name: NF525 chain extension verified
hunts.findings: VERIFIED CITED — Single audit_logs row 'order.refund.counter_entry' appended per refund via AuditLogService::write (RefundWithCounterEntryService:207-222) with payload {parent_order_id, parent_serial_no, parent_fiscal_sequence_no, mirror_fiscal_sequence_no, mirror_total, mirror_payments_count, reason}. HMAC SHA-256 chain extends correctly (AuditLogService is frozen-zone backend service per CLAUDE.md §7, append-only via BEFORE DELETE trigger that SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' on MySQL prod). Z reports for the day include the refund counter-entry properly via ZReportService::aggregate which: (a) sums orders.total in window (includes mirror with negative total = correct net), (b) sums order_payments per mode in window (includes mirror payments with negative amounts per iter15-P0-10 = correct per-mode net). Verified by RefundMirrorSplitPaymentTest::test_refund_z_reconciliation_under_credits_zero_after_fix — proves per-mode (cash, card) net=0 after refund. Also: fiscal channel log 'order.refund.counter_entry' line written best-effort (lines 224-234) for ops correlation.

hunts.name: Multi-refund attempt
hunts.findings: VERIFIED CITED — DOUBLE protection: (a) DB UNIQUE(orders.parent_order_id) via migration 2026_05_19_200000_add_unique_parent_order_id_to_orders.php (HEAL-A.3 / WAVE-L Z8 P0-1) — second mirror INSERT raises SQLSTATE 23000. (b) PosOrderController::refundWithCounterEntry catches QueryException 23000 -> returns stable 409 JSON {success:false, code:MIRROR_ALREADY_EXISTS, message:'Counter-entry already exists for this parent order.'} (PosOrderController.php:81-96 / HEAL-A.3-bis). Pre-A.3, only the in-service status-check guard at RefundWithCounterEntryService:83-88 caught duplicates — but NF525 immutability normally keeps parent.status stable, so the guard NEVER fired on the normal duplicate path (two distinct X-Idempotency-Key middleware passes -> two service entries -> two mirror creates -> 1st succeeds, 2nd silently created a second mirror against same parent = 2 Z negatives for 1 sale). Now both layers fire. UNIQUE index allows multiple NULL parent_order_id (MySQL + SQLite >=3.9 semantics) — non-mirror orders coexist. Sentinel: RefundCounterEntryUniqueParentTest.php (3 test cases including HTTP-level 409 attestation at line 223-269).

Add $this->loadMissing('parent') above the receipt block or eager-load in controller via $mirror->load(['orderItems','parent']).

new_findings_p0_p1_p2.title: Counter-entry path skips CashMovement — drawer expected-count silently skewed on post-Z cash refund
new_findings_p0_p1_p2.evidence: Verified by grep: RefundWithCounterEntryService.php has ZERO matches for `recordCashBackMovement` / `CashMovement::` / `cashService` / `CashDrawerService`. Counterpart PaymentService::cashBack DOES record a movement (PaymentService.php:471-508: TYPE_CASHBACK direction OUT, finds open session via CashDrawerService::findOpenSessionForUser, self-shielded with try/catch + Log::warning so failure does not abort outer tx). The post-Z refund path has no such hook.
new_findings_p0_p1_p2.impact: Z report aggregation BALANCES correctly because ZReportService::aggregate derives cash from order_payments rows and mirror OrderPayments with negated amounts ARE created (iter15-P0-10 fix at RefundWithCounterEntryService:175-204). But cash_drawer_sessions / cash_movements reconciliation surface — used at end-of-shift to compare expected count vs physical cash — has NO refund line. On a 50 EUR CASH refund: physical drawer is -50 EUR, but expected count (derived from cash_movements direction sums) is unchanged. Cashier sees an unexplainable ecart on the closing reconciliation. P1 because (a) Z balances correctly (no NF525 violation), (b) audit chain captures the refund forensically, (c) cashier CAN reconcile manually by inspecting audit_logs for the day. Not P0 because no money is lost or reported incorrectly to the tax authority.

loyalty_clawback_verification_end_to_end.wire_path: RefundWithCounterEntryService:260 RefundCreated::dispatch(parent) -> EventServiceProvider:195 ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund::class registered LAST in cascade -> ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund.php:43-94 handle() resolves user via loyalty_customer_code with kiosk user_id fallback -> LoyaltyService.php:141-199 clawbackEarnedPoints(user_id, awarded, order_id, reason) -> idempotent existence check on (user_id, order_id, type='manual_deduct') -> DB::transaction with lockForUpdate -> balance clamp at 0 -> manual_deduct LoyaltyTransaction insert with -actualDeducted points + 'refund' source_surface.
loyalty_clawback_verification_end_to_end.atomicity: RefundCreated uses DispatchableAfterCommit so listener fires only after outer RefundWithCounterEntryService DB::transaction COMMITS. Listener has its own DB::transaction (LoyaltyService.php:160-198) for the clawback ledger insert + user balance UPDATE. try/catch in listener (ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund.php:82-93) prevents clawback failure from blocking refund. Sibling listeners (Persist / Stock / Availability) run before — none depend on the clawback so its position LAST is correct.

loyalty_clawback_verification_end_to_end.interaction_with_refundPoints: RefundWithCounterEntryService.php:253 calls LoyaltyService::refundPoints(parent, 'pos') INSIDE the service transaction. refundPoints reverses REDEEM rows (writes type=manual_add / credits back points spent on the parent sale). ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund reverses EARN rows (writes type=manual_deduct / removes points earned on the parent sale). Both ledger types are distinct (separate ENUM values + separate UNIQUE keys), both can coexist for the same order_id. Net effect on a sale where customer (a) earned 300 points and (b) redeemed 100 points: clawback removes 300 from balance (or less if clamped), refundPoints adds 100 back to balance. Customer net loses what they spent on this transaction + what they earned — correct.
